{{Quote|Sir, we've lost control of just about everything, but if you can get to the communications room, you can jam their sensors so they don't know you're coming.|The officer talking to Kyle Katarn|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served as an '''officer''' in the [[New Republic Army]] who was stationed on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Altyr V base|base]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Altyr V]] around [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] worked with the base's [[Unidentified New Republic commander|commander]] and was present on the base when it was [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] by two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] weapons disguised as [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. The officer received communications from the long range outpost on [[Delta 3]] noting a large Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] heading for Altyr V, destined to arrive within three hours of the asteroids' attack. The Imperial weapons were eventually destroyed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]], allowing the base to evacuate before the primary Imperial fleet could arrive.

==Biography==
===Altyr V===
[[File:Four_angry_rebels.png|thumb|left|275px|The officer, far left, discusses the Imperial attack]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] enlisted into the [[New Republic Army]] sometime by [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], and was stationed on a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] base located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Altyr V]]. The officer commonly worked with the base's [[Unidentified New Republic commander|commander]], and worked primarily in the base's center of operations, generally known as [[Ops]]. The officer worked on [[Computer/Legends|computer]] terminals, and stayed in contact with a long range outpost on [[Delta 3]]. During the [[Operation Shadow Hand|campaign]] of the reborn [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in 10 ABY, two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] orbital [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion]] [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]], disguised as [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], were dispatched to Altyr V in order to hold down the New Republic base and keep the base's personnel from escaping as a larger Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] made it's way to Altyr V.<ref name="MOTS" />

The fleet happened to pass by Delta 3, however, and the listening post notified the officer of the incoming attack, suggesting that there was a three [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] window in which to escape the planet in. The officer then used the base's intercom in order to hail two visiting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to Ops. The Jedi were former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]]<ref name="MOTS" /> and former Imperial agent and [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy">''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''</ref> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], who had agreed to be stationed on the base. Katarn also doubled the assignment as an opportunity to train Jade as a Jedi, who had recently joined the New Republic.<ref name="MOTS" />

===The Battle of Altyr V===
[[File:Altyr_V_FT_vs_RT.png|thumb|right|200px|The Battle of Altyr V]]
{{Quote|Sir, our long range outpost on Delta 3 has picked up an Imperial strike force entering hyperspace.|The New Republic officer, to their commander|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
When the Jedi arrived in Ops, the officer and the base's [[Commander/Legends|commander]] explained the situation, looking to the Jedi for ideas. When the officer's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] indicated preliminary ground troops landing outside of the base's perimeters, Katarn devised a plan to steal an Imperial landing craft and fly it to the asteroid canons and destroy them from the inside. Katarn departed soon after, while Jade, the commander, and the officer remained in Ops. As Katarn made it to a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] blasted their way into Ops through a wall, smashing through New Republic resistance. The commander hailed for Katarn to return to Ops before he and Jade departed after temporarily beating off the stormtroopers. The officer remained in Ops, however.<ref name="MOTS" />

When Katarn finally made his way back, the stormtroopers began to attack Ops again, though were defeated this time with the Jedi's aid. The officer met Katarn on the second level of Ops, offering no insight on the whereabouts of Jade or the commander. Instead, the officer advised Katarn to seek out the base's communications center, and use it to jam Imperial sensors and [[Radar/Legends|radars]] in order to hide the fact Katarn was on his way to steal a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to take to the asteroids. Katarn wasn't able to reach the communications center, but Jade had found her way there instead and commenced with the jamming. Overall, Katarn's mission was successful, and the base was evacuated before the Imperial fleet could arrive.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Personality and traits==
The officer was skilled at his computer work, and knew how to handle his communication networks. During battle, the officer was level headed and business minded, wasting no time to provide assistance to Kyle Katarn as soon as the Jedi made his way back to Ops. The officer had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Equipment==
The officer wore a rather standard uniform for New Republic officers, which including a tan colored [[Clothing/Legends|jacket]], white pants, black boots, and a white cap. The officer was also armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] that fired green [[Laser/Legends|laser]] bolts. His command insignia carried five red pips.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The officer first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. Referred to as Rebel Officers in the game's manual, all officers were voiced by either [[Steve Blum]] or [[Roger Jackson]], though the game never makes it clear which of them voiced the officer in this article.

The officer's insignia shows five pips, which in previous media has distinguished either to belong to those with the rank of [[General/Legends|General]] or [[Captain/Legends|Captain]], though the game never clarifies the officer's rank in dialogue.
